verdict.rationale: Codex is designed to take natural-language task descriptions and autonomously edit/fix code across a repo, producing diffs and PRs (docs describe delegating tasks, inspecting diffs, opening PRs), and community evidence confirms real-world use for multi-file edits and fixes, calling it 'shockingly good' and comparable to a junior engineer, though with caveats on speed, quotas, and inconsistent reliability.
